cards.public_summary: Josh Downs said coaches will determine target distribution after the Colts added Keenan Allen alongside Alec Pierce and Tyler Warren.
cards.evidence:
Josh Downs, asked if he’s “curious” about how his target share will pan out after the #Colts added another high-volume WR in Keenan Allen, in addition to WR Alec Pierce and TE Tyler Warren:

“Nah, coach gon’ handle it how he wants to handle it. So, that’s his responsibility.” https://t.co/Y5TzXD4n2M
cards.commentary: Allen's addition introduces more target competition for Pierce, but the evidence provides no indication of how coaches will distribute routes, snaps or targets.
cards.author: James Boyd
